Designer Fragrance Shortlist

Switch between men's and women's, then tap a house to see every scent from it that has a Parfumo rating, ranked from best to worst. Ratings are Parfumo community scores out of 10, with the number of ratings in brackets. Scores from only a few ratings are pulled towards the average, so a 9.0 from 10 people doesn't outrank an 8.5 from 400. Men's tabs show men's and unisex scents, and women's tabs show women's and unisex, so the two overlap. Lists cover each house's 20 to 40 most popular scents on Parfumo. If a fragrance isn't here, type it in the search box and press Look up. For Arabian houses and Zara, 'Dupe of' names the scent reviewers and sellers say it copies, with a photo when that original is on these pages. 'Often compared to' means a looser likeness. These are community comparisons, not official claims.

Ratings last updated: November 2026 · source: Parfumo

Bottle photos and community ratings: Parfumo. Notes and "inspired by" come from the review and retail sources listed under each house. "Inspired by" means reviewers or sellers compare it to that fragrance. It appears only on Zara picks, and Zara doesn't confirm it. Sample before buying a full bottle. "Buy on Google" opens a Google Shopping search in a new tab; check the seller before buying, as grey-market and fake bottles are common.
